comment: Horde (UE-only; Combat/HordeRules.h, UHordeSubsystem). ONE trigger (game designer 2026-11-09): horde #12 - after N firefights IN A ROW on the level (level JSON "horde_after_firefights", default 10; UFirefightSubsystem / FirefightRules.h); the old horde after 240 s of real-time fight (trigger_seconds / repeats / repeat_seconds / count_increase_per_repeat, user request 2026-10-06) was removed 2026-11-09 and those keys are ignored. A firefight = one encounter with the level's enemies (patrols, ambushers, PMC) started by contact in which shots were exchanged with an aware enemy, or an ambush sprung on the squad; it ends when its enemies are down or after firefight_lost_contact_seconds without contact; slipping past an enemy group undetected (the squad came within its detection reach = its vision range clamped to firefight_slip_min/max_reach_m, it never spotted the squad, the squad left the reach x firefight_slip_exit_factor) resets the streak when firefight_slip_past_resets (confirmed by the game designer 2026-11-09); the HQ hints firefight_hint_before firefights early (1 = at 9 of 10), warns firefight_warning_seconds before the horde, then the horde intro. Per level: the level JSON "horde_enabled": false switches it off (2026-11-09: on at the Depot, off at the Lake and the PMC arenas), an optional "horde": { ...same keys... } overrides these values. WHERE (game designer play-test 2026-11-09: far away, somewhere new each time): the firefight horde spawns firefight_spawn_distance_m (300) +- firefight_spawn_spread_m (40) from the squad centre on a reachable navmesh point out of the squad's sight, at a random bearing at least firefight_bearing_change_deg (90) off the previous horde's (dropped only when no point off it exists; firefight_bearing_relax_share > 0 also drops it when the points off it reach under that share of the farthest distance); firefight_spawn_bearings directions are sampled; a map with no point that far (the Depot is 177 x 124 m) takes a random one among the points >= firefight_fallback_share x the farthest reachable out-of-sight distance (logged); min_distance_m / max_distance_m (25-45) are only the dev command CodexTactics.Horde.Release's band. WHO (game designer 2026-11-09): waves_feed_horde true = on a level that does not play its level-JSON waves as scripted waves (an ambush-start level such as the Depot) the waves feed the firefight hordes in order (horde 1 = wave 1, 2 = wave 2, 3 = wave 3, then the last wave repeats; inactive waves skipped), each with its max_simultaneous_enemies (the most alive at once, the rest follow from the horde's spawn point as they fall), wave_modifiers and custom_stats, a SPITTER entry coming as the MILITARY_ZOMBIE; otherwise (no waves, a level whose waves run as scripted fights, or false) count + composition below. Distances in meters, times in seconds. composition = weights per level-JSON enemy type (HOUND / FROST_HOUND, FROSTBITTEN, MILITARY_ZOMBIE = a Frostbitten variant Blueprint, BRUTE, CUTTER, MARKSMAN, CRYO_DRONE); the SPITTER is refused (the Military Zombie took its place outside the stage waves, horde #12 / task #34, confirmed by the game designer 2026-11-09). Console: Codex.Horde.Enabled / Codex.Horde.AfterFirefights / Codex.Horde.FirefightWarningSeconds (-1 = data), CodexTactics.Horde.Release (direct release, no warning).
